lines.beaver_en: You said you had something to tell me?
lines.learner: 응, 그런데 말을 꺼내자니 좀 민망하네.
lines.en: Yeah, but it's awkward to bring it up.
lines.roman: Eung, geureonde mareul kkeonaejani jom minmanghane.

lines.beaver_en: It's okay. Please tell me freely.
lines.learner: 네가 낸 기획안 말이야. 부득이 보류됐어.
lines.en: About your proposal. It had to be put on hold.
lines.roman: Nega naen gihoegan mariya. Budeugi boryudwaesseo.

lines.en: I was bewildered too. It was absurd.

lines.beaver: 그 기획안에 정말 공을 많이 들였는데요.
lines.beaver_en: I put so much effort into that proposal.
lines.beaver_roman: Geu gihoegane jeongmal gongeul mani deuryeonneundeyo.
lines.en: I know. That's why I feel even sorrier for you.

lines.beaver_en: I'm sorry. I guess I wasn't good enough.
lines.en: No, it's purely the company's situation.

lines.beaver_en: How did you feel when you heard it?
lines.en: At first I was shocked, then I could only sigh.

lines.beaver_en: What was the mood in the meeting?
lines.learner: 한 분 말투가 좀 거슬리고 불쾌했어.
lines.en: One person's tone was jarring and unpleasant.
lines.roman: Han bun maltuga jom geoseulligo bulkwaehaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have been upset too.
lines.en: Yeah, telling you makes my emotions well up.

lines.beaver_en: The reaction was good when we first presented.
lines.learner: 맞아, 다들 감탄했지. 나도 소름 돋았어.
lines.en: Right, everyone was impressed. I got goosebumps too.
lines.roman: Maja, dadeul gamtanhaetji. Nado soreum dodasseo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll try again. Please cheer me on.
lines.learner: 그래, 응원할게. 그때 그 감격 다시 느껴 보자.
lines.en: Sure, I'll cheer you on. Let's feel that thrill again.
lines.roman: Geurae, eungwonhalge. Geuttae geu gamgyeok dasi neukkyeo boja.
